English is preferred; Russian proposals are welcome. Use synthetic examples only.
Do not include PII, secrets, private hosts, keys, manifests/routes or restored text.
Report vulnerabilities privately through the repository SECURITY policy instead.

## Acceptance evidence

Describe a reproducible synthetic check and consumer-facing result. Mark any
proposed public API/CLI, security, trust or release impact explicitly. A proposal
is not approval to change contracts, expand authority or publish a package.
